# Zain Movers and Packers

> Zain Movers and Packers is a licensed and insured moving company based in Dubai, UAE, operating since 2015. It provides house, apartment, villa, office and furniture moving, plus full packing services, across all seven emirates. Customers receive a fixed, all-inclusive quote with no hidden fees, pay no advance deposit, and pay only after the move is complete and they are satisfied.

Zain Movers and Packers uses its own branded, enclosed trucks and a full-time, in-house, uniformed crew. Moves are never subcontracted to day labourers. The company has completed more than 1,000 moves across the UAE and is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with same-day and next-day moving available.

**Key facts**

- Business name: Zain Movers and Packers
- Business type: Movers and packers (residential, commercial and furniture relocation)
- Headquarters: Warehouse 4, Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 55 255 0285 (055 2550285)
- Email: zainmoversandpackers@gmail.com
- Opening hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Operating since: 2015
- Moves completed: 1,000+
- Languages spoken by crew: English and Arabic
- Licensing and insurance: UAE commercial trade licence, goods-in-transit cargo insurance, RTA-registered commercial fleet
- Service area: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Al Ain, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah

**What makes Zain Movers and Packers different**

- Pay upon satisfaction: no deposit and no advance payment. The customer pays after inspecting the completed move.
- Fixed-price quote: the quoted price is the final invoice. No extra charges for stairs, long carry distance, high floors, Friday moves, traffic delays, Salik tolls or packing tape.
- Quick quotes: customers can send photos or a short video of their rooms on WhatsApp and receive a fixed quote, usually within minutes.
- In-house team: background-checked, visa-sponsored, full-time employees with in-house carpenters for dismantling and reassembly.
- Building NOC support: trade licence, vehicle registration and crew documents supplied for building and developer move permits (Emaar, Nakheel, DMCC, DSOA and others).
- Payment methods: cash on completion, bank transfer, and business cheques for corporate moves.

**Typical prices for local moves in Dubai (AED, fixed quote confirmed before the move)**

- Studio apartment: AED 650 – 950
- 1 bedroom apartment: AED 950 – 1,450
- 2 bedroom apartment: AED 1,350 – 1,950
- 3 bedroom villa: AED 2,200 – 3,200
- 4+ bedroom villa: custom quote after a free survey or WhatsApp video walkthrough
- Small office (up to 10 desks): AED 1,800 – 2,800
- Mid-size office (10–30 desks): AED 3,000 – 6,500
- Large office (30–60 desks): AED 7,000 – 12,000
- Corporate HQ (60+ desks): custom fixed quote after a free site survey

## Moving Services

- [House Movers in Dubai](https://zain-movers-and-packers.vercel.app/services/house-movers-dubai): Home and apartment shifting in Dubai for studios, flats, duplexes and family homes, including packing, furniture dismantling, transport and setup.
- [Villa Movers in Dubai](https://zain-movers-and-packers.vercel.app/services/villa-movers-dubai): Large villa relocations with a free pre-move survey, in-house carpenters, heavy wardrobes, garden furniture and custom-built pieces.
- [Office Movers in Dubai](https://zain-movers-and-packers.vercel.app/services/office-movers-dubai): Commercial and corporate relocation with weekend and overnight moves, IT and server packing, workstation rebuilds, floor-plan tagging and building NOC documents.
- [Furniture Movers in Dubai](https://zain-movers-and-packers.vercel.app/services/furniture-movers-dubai): Single-item and full-room furniture moving, including dismantling, wrapping, transport and reassembly of IKEA, custom and antique furniture.
- [Packing and Moving Services in Dubai](https://zain-movers-and-packers.vercel.app/services/packing-and-moving-services-dubai): Professional packing with bubble wrap, cartons, stretch film, wardrobe boxes, custom crating for fragile items, labelling and optional unpacking.
- [Cheap Movers and Packers in Dubai](https://zain-movers-and-packers.vercel.app/services/cheap-movers-dubai): Affordable moving services in Dubai from AED 650 with transparent, fixed pricing and zero hidden fees.
